# Tool Analysis: Magento CMS Page Search & Filter

## Step Analysis
The recorded steps show a Magento admin CMS page management interface where the agent:
1. Navigated to the CMS page management URL (after login)
2. Identified filter controls for searching/filtering CMS pages
3. Extracted page structure showing filter fields: Title, URL Key, Status, Layout, Store View, Date Created, Last Modified
4. Identified interactive elements but got stuck in scroll/extract loops without demonstrating actual interactions

## Task Definition
Create a tool to search and filter CMS pages in Magento admin using various criteria including page title, URL key, status, layout, store view, and date ranges.

## Action Plan
1. Navigate to CMS page management interface
2. Fill Title filter input (optional)
3. Fill URL Key filter input (optional)  
4. Select Status filter (optional)
5. Select Layout filter (optional)
6. Select Store View filter (optional)
7. Fill Date Created range filters (optional)
8. Fill Last Modified range filters (optional)
9. Click Search button to apply filters
10. Extract filtered results

## Variable Identification
Based on the extracted HTML structure:
- `title`: Page title filter (input name='title')
- `identifier`: URL key filter (input name='identifier') 
- `is_active`: Status filter (select name='is_active') - values: "1" for Enabled, "0" for Disabled
- `root_template`: Layout filter (select name='root_template') - values from options
- `store_id`: Store View filter (select name='store_id') - values from options
- `created_at[from]`: Date Created from filter (input name='created_at[from]')
- `created_at[to]`: Date Created to filter (input name='created_at[to]')
- `update_time[from]`: Last Modified from filter (input name='update_time[from]')
- `update_time[to]`: Last Modified to filter (input name='update_time[to]')

## Step Optimization
- All filter fields are optional (no required fields for search/filter functionality)
- Use deterministic steps with CSS selectors based on name attributes
- Add wait steps for page loading after navigation
- Use agent step for extracting results since page content is dynamic
- Note: Authentication is handled separately (agent is already logged in)
name: magento_cms_page_search_filter
description: Search, filter, and manage CMS content pages in Magento admin by user-provided criteria (title, URL key, status)

steps.description: Navigate to Magento admin CMS page management interface
Wait for page to load completely
Filter by date created from (optional, format: MM/DD/YYYY)
Filter by date created to (optional, format: MM/DD/YYYY)
Filter by last modified from (optional, format: MM/DD/YYYY)
Filter by last modified to (optional, format: MM/DD/YYYY)
Click Search button to apply filters
Wait for filter results to load
